paper.abstract_en: The S matrix on an asymptotically-flat Schwarzschild black hole is studied as a function of position on $\mathcal{I}$. We derive the lightcone singularities that arise in the S matrix whenever the two points on $\mathcal{I}$ are connected by a bulk null geodesic. This includes geodesics orbiting near the photon sphere for a long time, whose kinematics determine the associated lightcone singularities. By turning on a finite string length $\ell_s$, worldsheet corrections are shown to shift the lightcone singularities into the complex time plane, resolving the singularities at real times. In particular, we derive the leading stringy resolution of the photon sphere singularities. We also compute stringy corrections to the eikonal quasinormal mode spectrum of Schwarzschild, and discuss the kinematics of strings orbiting the photon sphere.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究 Schwarzschild 黑洞上 S 矩阵的光锥奇异性，特别是光子球附近长轨道零测地线对应的奇点，并引入有限弦长 $\ell_s$ 的世界面修正将其移入复时间平面，同时计算对 eikonal 准正规模谱的弦修正。属于引力基础与黑洞物理交叉的实质性理论研究，理论深度高，对研究黑洞散射与准正规模的读者有明确的相关性。
decision.abstract_zh: 本文将渐近平直 Schwarzschild 黑洞上的 S 矩阵作为 $\mathcal{I}$ 上位置的函数进行研究。我们推导出当 $\mathcal{I}$ 上的两点由体区零测地线相连时，S 矩阵中出现的光锥奇异性。这包括长时间绕行于光子球附近的测地线，其运动学决定了相应的光锥奇异性。通过引入有限的弦长 $\ell_s$，世界面修正被证明会将光锥奇异性移入复时间平面，从而在实时间处解析这些奇异性。特别地，我们推导出光子球奇异性的领头弦论式解析。我们还计算了 Schwarzschild 的 eikonal 准正规模谱的弦修正，并讨论了绕行光子球的弦的运动学。
